episodes.name: Necklacegate 90210
episodes.plot: Meet LA's Asian socialites. Chinatown comes to Beverly Hills, just for Christine. Anna jets Kelly to Paris for her birthday, then sends a message.

episodes.name: Tale of Two Trusts
episodes.plot: Ill will lingers as Christine faces Anna, who shows her hand — and more — to Kevin while playing matchmaker. Family pressure looms for the Chius.

translations.value: Ill will lingers as Christine faces Anna, who shows her hand — and more — to Kevin while playing matchmaker. Family pressure looms for the Chius.

episodes.plot: Cherie welcomes her baby while still expecting a proposal. Kim and Anna clash after a raunchy discovery. Kelly throws a party — who threw the drink?

episodes.name: Beverly Hills Heartbreak
episodes.plot: Kim strikes out at Kane's bowling bash. Christine confronts Gabe. Kevin explores his origins. Andrew hurls accusations, and Kelly makes her move.

translations.value: Kim strikes out at Kane's bowling bash. Christine confronts Gabe. Kevin explores his origins. Andrew hurls accusations, and Kelly makes her move.

episodes.name: Private Lies
episodes.plot: It's birthdays and Botox as Kevin strips and Christine impresses. Kim hunts for her dad. Kelly and Kevin step out, but can she resist Andrew's lead?

translations.value: It's birthdays and Botox as Kevin strips and Christine impresses. Kim hunts for her dad. Kelly and Kevin step out, but can she resist Andrew's lead?

episodes.name: The Other Side
episodes.plot: Kelly plays with fire — and Andrew. Medium Tyler Henry helps Cherie find closure. Blocked in both love and life, Kevin breaks down during hypnosis.

translations.value: Kelly plays with fire — and Andrew. Medium Tyler Henry helps Cherie find closure. Blocked in both love and life, Kevin breaks down during hypnosis.

episodes.name: Kevin and Kane Take Charleston
episodes.plot: Tired of the judgement, Kelly dodges rumors. Kim worries about reconnecting with her father, so Kevin and Kane embark on an excellent adventure.

translations.value: Tired of the judgement, Kelly dodges rumors. Kim worries about reconnecting with her father, so Kevin and Kane embark on an excellent adventure.

episodes.name: Will You Marry Me?
episodes.plot: Kevin breaks the heartrending news to Kim. "E is for Hermès" as the friends shop the feelings away in Vegas. Cherie shocks everybody.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.plot: Shoes off: Kevin reveals his digs and reconnects with Kim. Kane broadcasts Kelly's status. Have Anna and Christine made up? Jessey's history emerges.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.plot: A groggy Kane dives into the sex talk. A date nose-dives, a secret drops, and Kim makes a confession. Cherie meets famed stylist Nicola Formichetti.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.plot: Emotions run high over truffles and dim sum as Kim and Kevin spar and gossip spreads. Dorothy dishes with Jaime about dating — and bad blood with Kane.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.plot: Unable to find a resolution, Kane airs his issues. Kevin and Kim road test a budding relationship. Kelly breaks down and grabs some rays.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.plot: What's real? Christine looks for Baby G's new pet and discusses her fears. Kim and Kevin wing it, but Kane shoots down all hope. Time for a showdown.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.plot: A blowup at Kane's blowout spirals into the store and fuels rumors. Has the bro code been broken forever? Actor Lewis Tan reaches out to Jaime.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.plot: A feng shui expert visits Kane's home. Kevin cooks up some romance, but Kim calls for a lie detector. On Father's Day, Christine weighs surrogates.

episodes.name: Battle Royale
episodes.plot: The truth hurts: Kevin faces the facts about love and career. Dorothy makes a move to NYC. Kane confronts Christine, who goes head-to-head with Anna.

translations.value: The truth hurts: Kevin faces the facts about love and career. Dorothy makes a move to NYC. Kane confronts Christine, who goes head-to-head with Anna.

seasons.name: Stagione 3
seasons.plot: Unfinished business and big opportunities stir up tension in the group, but nothing will stop them from living their flashiest and most fabulous lives.

episodes.name: Episodio 1

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: Kevin non reagisce bene alle notizie di Kane riguardo al lavoro con Fenty. Kelly riceve una sorpresa durante un viaggio improvviso in Messico. Kim fa la pace con Anna.

episodes.plot: Una telefonata da "Dancing With the Stars" rianima Christine dopo una dolorosa notizia. Kelly porta Kevin, Kim e Kane a Malibu per risolvere alcuni problemi.
